Subject: Renewal QBR / roadmap demo — dates to pick

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well — we’re lining up the renewal QBR and a short roadmap demo for the execs and product team at Clearline. Our renewal target is end of December so we want to lock a slot in the next two weeks.

Ideal goals for the session:
- 45 minute product demo focused on inference economics and routing controls
- 30 minute roadmap discussion with engineering and account execs
- 15 minute open Q&A and next steps

We have these windows available on our side (PST):
- Tue, Nov 19: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu, Nov 21: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:30

Can you confirm which of those works for Redwood and if you need a dedicated exec time? Adding Monica from our side for ops coordination.

Thanks,
Jordan

- Thu, Nov 21: 09:00–11:00 (preferred)
